mapper.insert: INSERT INTO index_jobs() VALUES(#{id},#{repositoryId},#{jobType},#{status},#{currentStep},#{errorMessage},#{startedAt},#{finishedAt},#{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET status=EXCLUDED.status,current_step=EXCLUDED.current_step,error_message=EXCLUDED.error_message,started_at=EXCLUDED.started_at,finished_at=EXCLUDED.finished_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM index_jobs WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM index_jobs WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC
SELECT FROM index_jobs ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT j.id,j.repo_id,j.job_type,j.status,j.current_step,j.error_message,j.started_at,j.finished_at,j.created_at FROM index_jobs j JOIN repositories r ON r.id=j.repo_id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN repository_permissions p ON p.repo_id=r.id AND p.account_id=#{accountId} WHERE #{admin}=TRUE OR r.owner_account_id=#{accountId} OR p.account_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY j.created_at DESC,j.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM index_jobs WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND status IN('QUEUED','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED')
SELECT FROM index_jobs WHERE status='QUEUED' AND job_type IN('FULL','INCREMENTAL') ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 1

WITH candidate AS(SELECT id FROM index_jobs WHERE status='QUEUED' AND job_type IN('FULL','INCREMENTAL') ORDER BY created_at,id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1) UPDATE index_jobs job SET status='RUNNING',current_step='scan_repository',started_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM candidate WHERE job.id=candidate.id RETURNING job.*
